## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
CAUTION. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive; strong sector breadth but large-cap 1W/1M divergences (NVDA/TSLA/AAPL/MSFT/INTC among others) create conflicting signals, supporting CAUTION. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5).

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Communication lead: CMCSA (1W: +2.43% | 1M: +12.29%) ABOVE TREND, TMUS (1W: +4.11% | 1M: -2.49%) RECOVERY. Utilities strong on the week: D (1W: +3.22% | 1M: -4.85%) RECOVERY. Real Estate showing pickup: AMT (1W: +3.43% | 1M: -1.56%) RECOVERY, CCI (1W: +3.09% | 1M: -1.23%) RECOVERY.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Financials lag on the week: JPM (1W: +0.10% | 1M: +3.30%) ABOVE TREND but sector weak overall; MET (1W: -1.93% | 1M: +4.21%) CORRECTION. Industrials mixed: CAT (1W: -0.86% | 1M: +0.28%) CORRECTION, BA (1W: +0.77% | 1M: +15.61%) ABOVE TREND but uneven breadth. Consumer Discretionary shows intra-sector divergence: TSLA (1W: -7.02% | 1M: +5.64%) CORRECTION vs NKE (1W: +6.94% | 1M: -4.72%) RECOVERY.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: NKE (1W: +6.94% | 1M: -4.72%) RECOVERY; TMUS (1W: +4.11% | 1M: -2.49%) RECOVERY; AMT (1W: +3.43% | 1M: -1.56%) RECOVERY; D (1W: +3.22% | 1M: -4.85%) RECOVERY; CCI (1W: +3.09% | 1M: -1.23%) RECOVERY — Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5), but many are short-term bounces versus weaker 1M.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: TXN (1W: -1.90% | 1M: +4.25%) CORRECTION; MET (1W: -1.93% | 1M: +4.21%) CORRECTION; DD (1W: -1.93% | 1M: +2.29%) CORRECTION; AXP (1W: -1.96% | 1M: +2.22%) CORRECTION; PEP (1W: -1.97% | 1M: -2.13%) BELOW TREND — Weakness concentrated in episodic financial/industrial names and select consumer staples.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Top 1W movers: NKE (1W: +6.94% | 1M: -4.72%) RECOVERY; TMUS (1W: +4.11% | 1M: -2.49%) RECOVERY; AMT (1W: +3.43% | 1M: -1.56%) RECOVERY; note many momentum names are RECOVERIES (1W up, 1M down) — major divergence: treat as tactical bounces, not confirmed trend shifts. Watch INTC (1W: +2.56% | 1M: -8.04%) RECOVERY given negative news sentiment (−45).

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Mixed but still important: NVDA (1W: +2.10% | 1M: +5.96%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +0.53% | 1M: -0.92%) RECOVERY, AAPL (1W: +0.78% | 1M: -2.07%) RECOVERY; several large-cap techs are RECOVERIES while NVDA/META are ABOVE TREND — sector breadth: Tech ~11/19 positive (internal rotation).

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Mixed: JPM (1W: +0.10% | 1M: +3.30%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +0.43% | 1M: +5.73%) ABOVE TREND, but banks show one-week softness and select names in CORRECTION (MET, AXP) — sector breadth: Financials ~8/20 positive, signaling internal rotation.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Patchy: UNH (1W: +2.15% | 1M: +1.40%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +0.30% | 1M: +0.40%) ABOVE TREND, but JNJ (1W: -0.20% | 1M: +0.00%) treated as CORRECTION here amid negative trial news — sector breadth: Healthcare ~10/15 positive but news-driven divergences.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Favor exposure to names showing confirmed ABOVE TREND leadership (NVDA (1W: +2.10% | 1M: +5.96%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +2.40% | 1M: +4.37%) ABOVE TREND, CMCSA (1W: +2.43% | 1M: +12.29%) ABOVE TREND) while reducing exposure to high-volatility CORRECTION cases (TSLA (1W: -7.02% | 1M: +5.64%) CORRECTION, TXN (1W: -1.90% | 1M: +4.25%) CORRECTION). Style: mixed / no clear leadership; stay selective and prioritize confirmed ABOVE TREND names.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: NVDA (1W: +2.10% | 1M: +5.96%) ABOVE TREND; CMCSA (1W: +2.43% | 1M: +12.29%) ABOVE TREND; XOM (1W: +2.40% | 1M: +4.37%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: TSLA (1W: -7.02% | 1M: +5.64%) CORRECTION; JNJ (1W: -0.20% | 1M: +0.00%) CORRECTION; INTC (1W: +2.56% | 1M: -8.04%) RECOVERY given negative headlines.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Communication (CMCSA/T) — sector 1W positive; Energy (XOM/CVX) showing ABOVE TREND names.  
BEARISH: Financials (mixed weekly performance) and Consumer Discretionary (TSLA shock) — watch dispersion within each sector.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
NVDA (1W: +2.10% | 1M: +5.96%) ABOVE TREND — watch for continuation above recent highs as confirmation. AAPL (1W: +0.78% | 1M: -2.07%) RECOVERY — monitor support near recent 1W pivot. TSLA (1W: -7.02% | 1M: +5.64%) CORRECTION — watch follow-through below the week’s lows for trend break.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
MA (+75): MA (1W: +0.30% | 1M: +4.88%) ABOVE TREND — buyback headline confirms price strength. NVDA (+65): NVDA (1W: +2.10% | 1M: +5.96%) ABOVE TREND — chip demand news confirms accumulation. BA (+55): BA (1W: +0.77% | 1M: +15.61%) ABOVE TREND — contract news aligns with strong 1M performance.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
JNJ (-55): JNJ (1W: -0.20% | 1M: +0.00%) CORRECTION — trial failure headline diverges from flat 1M, downside risk. TSLA (-55): TSLA (1W: -7.02% | 1M: +5.64%) CORRECTION — delivery outlook confirms price weakness. INTC (-45): INTC (1W: +2.56% | 1M: -8.04%) RECOVERY — negative headlines contradict short-term bounce, monitor for follow-through.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION; style mixed / no clear leadership. NVDA (1W: +2.10% | 1M: +5.96%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +2.40% | 1M: +4.37%) ABOVE TREND and CMCSA (1W: +2.43% | 1M: +12.29%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength. Key risk: pervasive 1W/1M divergences (TSLA CORRECTION, INTC RECOVERY, JNJ headlines) — monitor news flow and trend confirmation.
